verses.kjv: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.modern: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah the prophet, son of Berechiah, son of Iddo. He said:

verses.kjv: The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
verses.modern: "The LORD was greatly displeased with Your fathers.

verses.kjv: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: Return to Me, says the LORD of hosts, and I will return to You, says the LORD of hosts.'

verses.kjv: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Do not be like Your fathers, to whom the earlier prophets cried out, saying, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: Turn now from Your evil ways and Your evil deeds.' But they would not hear or listen to Me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
verses.modern: Where are Your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?

verses.kjv: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the LORD of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.
verses.modern: But did not My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, take hold of Your fathers? Then they turned back and said, 'Just as the LORD of hosts purposed to do to us, according to our ways and according to our deeds, so has He dealt with us.'"

verses.kjv: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.modern: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah the prophet, son of Berechiah, son of Iddo. He said:

verses.kjv: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
verses.modern: I saw in the night a man riding on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in the valley. Behind Him were red horses, speckled horses, and white horses.

verses.kjv: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.
verses.modern: Then I said, "My lord, what are these?" The angel who talked with me said, "I will show you what these are."

verses.kjv: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
verses.modern: And the man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, "These are the ones whom the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth."

verses.kjv: And they answered the angel of the LORD that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.
verses.modern: And they answered the angel of the LORD Who stood among the myrtle trees, saying, "We have gone back and forth through the earth, and all the earth sits still and is at rest."

verses.kjv: Then the angel of the LORD answered and said, O LORD of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?
verses.modern: Then the angel of the LORD answered, "O LORD of hosts, how long will You not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which You have had indignation these seventy years?"

verses.kjv: And the LORD answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.
verses.modern: And the LORD answered the angel who talked with me with good and comforting words.

verses.kjv: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
verses.modern: So the angel who spoke with me said to me, "Cry out, saying, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

verses.kjv: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
verses.modern: And I am greatly displeased with the heathen who are at ease. For I was only a little displeased, and they made the affliction worse.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: I have returned to Jerusalem with mercies. My house shall be built in it, says the LORD of hosts, and a measuring line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Cry out again, saying, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: My cities shall yet overflow with prosperity. The LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.'"

verses.kjv: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
verses.modern: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and there were four horns.

verses.kjv: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
verses.modern: And I said to the angel who talked with me, "What are these?" He answered me, "These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: And the LORD shewed me four carpenters.
verses.modern: And the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

verses.kjv: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.
verses.modern: Then I said, "What are these coming to do?" And He said, "These are the horns that scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up His head. But these craftsmen have come to terrify them and to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it."

chapters.summary: The LORD calls the people to return to Him, not to be like their fathers who ignored the prophets. Zechariah sees a vision of a man riding a red horse among the myrtle trees — the horsemen report that all the earth sits still and is at rest. The LORD declares He is sore displeased with the nations at ease and will return to Jerusalem with mercies; His house will be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.modern: I lifted up my eyes again and looked, and there was a man with a measuring line in his hand.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
verses.modern: Then I said, "Where are You going?" And He said to me, "To measure Jerusalem, to see how wide it is and how long it is."

verses.kjv: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.modern: And the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet Him,

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
verses.modern: and said to Him, "Run, speak to this young man, saying, 'Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls, because of the great number of men and cattle in it.

verses.kjv: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
verses.modern: For I, says the LORD, will be a wall of fire all around her, and will be the glory in her midst.'

verses.kjv: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Up, up! Come out and flee from the land of the north, says the LORD. For I have spread You abroad as the four winds of heaven, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
verses.modern: Deliver Yourself, O Zion, You who live with the daughter of Babylon.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD of hosts says: After the glory, He has sent Me to the nations that plundered you. For he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

verses.kjv: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.
verses.modern: For I will shake My hand against them, and they shall become plunder for their servants. Then You shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent Me.

verses.kjv: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion. For I am coming, and I will live in your midst, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
verses.modern: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be My people. I will live in Your midst, and You shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent Me to You.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
verses.modern: And the LORD shall inherit Judah as His portion in the holy land, and shall again choose Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
verses.modern: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD, for He is roused from His holy dwelling.

chapters.summary: Zechariah sees a man with a measuring line going to measure Jerusalem. An angel declares that Jerusalem will be inhabited as towns without walls because of the multitude of people and cattle. The LORD Himself will be a wall of fire around her and the glory in her midst. "Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion, for I am coming and I will dwell in your midst."

verses.kjv: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
verses.modern: And He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
verses.modern: And the LORD said to Satan, "The LORD rebuke You, O Satan! The LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke You! Is this not a brand plucked out of the fire?"

verses.kjv: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
verses.modern: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.

verses.kjv: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
verses.modern: And he answered and said to those who stood before him, "Take away the filthy garments from him." And to him he said, "See, I have taken your iniquity from you, and I will clothe you with a change of clothing."

verses.kjv: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the LORD stood by.
verses.modern: And I said, "Let them set a clean mitre on His head." So they set a clean mitre on His head and clothed Him with garments. And the angel of the LORD stood by.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD protested unto Joshua, saying,
verses.modern: And the angel of the LORD charged Joshua, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts says: If You will walk in My ways and if You will keep My charge, then You shall also judge My house and also keep My courts. And I will give You places to walk among these who stand by.

verses.kjv: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.
verses.modern: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men of sign. For I am going to bring forth My servant the BRANCH.

verses.kjv: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
verses.modern: For see the stone that I have laid before Joshua. On one stone shall be seven eyes. I will engrave its inscription, says the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

verses.kjv: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
verses.modern: In that day, says the LORD of hosts, every man shall call his neighbor to sit under his vine and under His fig tree."

chapters.summary: Zechariah sees Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, with Satan at his right hand to accuse him. The LORD rebukes Satan, strips Joshua's filthy garments, and clothes him with clean robes. The LORD promises to bring forth His servant the BRANCH and to remove the iniquity of the land in one day.

verses.kjv: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.
verses.modern: And the angel who talked with me came again and woke me, as a man is wakened out of his sleep.

verses.kjv: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
verses.modern: And He said to me, "What do You see?" And I said, "I have looked, and there is a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it, with seven pipes to the seven lamps that are on the top of it.

verses.kjv: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
verses.modern: And two olive trees are by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on its left side."

verses.kjv: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
verses.modern: So I answered and said to the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"

verses.kjv: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.modern: Then the angel who talked with me answered and said to me, "Do You not know what these are?" And I said, "No, my lord."

verses.kjv: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: Then He answered and said to me, "This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
verses.modern: Who are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you shall become a plain. And he shall bring out the headstone with shouts of, 'Grace, grace to it!'"

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.kjv: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.
verses.modern: "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it. Then You shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent Me to You.

verses.kjv: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
verses.modern: For who has despised the day of small things? For they shall rejoice and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven. They are the eyes of the LORD, which run back and forth through the whole earth."

verses.kjv: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
verses.modern: Then I answered and said to Him, "What are these two olive trees on the right side of the candlestick and on its left side?"

verses.kjv: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
verses.modern: And I answered again and said to Him, "What are these two olive branches that, through the two golden pipes, empty the golden oil out of themselves?"

verses.kjv: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.modern: And He answered me and said, "Do You not know what these are?" And I said, "No, my lord."

verses.kjv: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.modern: Then He said, "These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth."

chapters.summary: Zechariah sees a golden candlestick with seven lamps and two olive trees on either side. The angel declares to Zerubbabel: "Not by might, nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of hosts." The mountain before Zerubbabel will become a plain, and he will bring forth the headstone with shouts of "Grace, grace to it!" The two olive trees are the two anointed ones who stand before the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.kjv: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.
verses.modern: Then I turned and lifted up my eyes and looked, and there was a flying scroll.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
verses.modern: And he said to me, "What do you see?" And I answered, "I see a flying scroll. Its length is twenty cubits, and its width is ten cubits."

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.
verses.modern: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that goes out over the face of the whole earth. For everyone who steals shall be cut off according to what is written on this side of it, and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to what is written on the other side.

verses.kjv: I will bring it forth, saith the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
verses.modern: I will send it out, says the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter the house of the thief and the house of Him who swears falsely by My name. It shall remain in the middle of His house and shall consume it, with its timber and its stones."

verses.kjv: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.
verses.modern: Then the angel who talked with me went out and said to me, "Lift up Your eyes now, and see what is going out."

verses.kjv: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
verses.modern: And I said, "What is it?" And He said, "This is an ephah going out." He said further, "This is their appearance throughout the earth.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.
verses.modern: And a talent of lead was lifted up, and there was a woman sitting inside the ephah."

verses.kjv: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
verses.modern: And He said, "This is wickedness." And He thrust her back into the middle of the ephah, and threw the lead weight on its mouth.

verses.kjv: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
verses.modern: Then I lifted up my eyes and looked, and two women came out, with the wind in their wings. For they had wings like the wings of a stork. And they lifted up the ephah between earth and heaven.

verses.kjv: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
verses.modern: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, "Where are they taking the ephah?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
verses.modern: And He said to me, "To build a house for it in the land of Shinar. And when it is ready, it shall be set there on its own base."

chapters.summary: Zechariah sees a flying scroll — the curse going out over the whole land against every thief and every one who swears falsely. He then sees a woman called Wickedness sitting in a basket, and two women with wings like the wings of a stork carry the basket away to the land of Shinar to build a house for it.

verses.kjv: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
verses.modern: And I turned and lifted up my eyes and looked, and four chariots came out from between two mountains. And the mountains were mountains of brass.

verses.kjv: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
verses.modern: In the first chariot were red horses, and in the second chariot black horses,

verses.kjv: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
verses.modern: and in the third chariot white horses, and in the fourth chariot dappled, strong horses.

verses.kjv: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?
verses.modern: Then I answered and said to the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"

verses.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.modern: And the angel answered and said to me, "These are the four spirits of the heavens, going out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

verses.kjv: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
verses.modern: The chariot with the black horses is going to the north country, the white go out after them, and the dappled go out toward the south country."

verses.kjv: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
verses.modern: And the strong horses went out, eager to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. And He said, "Go from here, walk back and forth through the earth." So they walked back and forth through the earth.

verses.kjv: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
verses.modern: Then He cried out to me and said, "See, those who go toward the north country have given My Spirit rest in the north country."

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
verses.modern: "Take a gift from the exiles, from Heldai, from Tobijah, and from Jedaiah, who have come from Babylon. And go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

verses.kjv: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
verses.modern: Then take silver and gold and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua son of Josedech, the high priest.

verses.kjv: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:
verses.modern: And speak to Him, saying, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: See the man whose name is The BRANCH. And he shall grow up out of His place, and He shall build the temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
verses.modern: Yes, He shall build the temple of the LORD, and He shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule on His throne. And He shall be a priest on His throne, and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.'

verses.kjv: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
verses.modern: And the crowns shall be for Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen son of Zephaniah, as a memorial in the temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.modern: And those who are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and You shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me to You. And this shall come to pass, if You will diligently obey the voice of the LORD Your God."

chapters.summary: Zechariah sees four chariots with horses of different colors going out from between two mountains of brass — the four spirits of heaven going throughout the earth. The LORD commands Zechariah to make crowns for Joshua the high priest and declare: "The man whose name is the BRANCH shall build the temple of the LORD, and He shall bear the glory and sit and rule on His throne — and He shall be a priest on His throne."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
verses.modern: And it came to pass in the fourth year of King Darius that the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

verses.kjv: When they had sent unto the house of God Sharezer and Regemmelech, and their men, to pray before the LORD,
verses.modern: When the people had sent Sherezer, Regem-melech, and their men to the house of God to pray before the LORD,

verses.kjv: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
verses.modern: and to speak to the priests who were in the house of the LORD of hosts and to the prophets, saying, "Should I weep in the fifth month, setting myself apart, as I have done these many years?"

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
verses.modern: "Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, 'When You fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even for those seventy years, did You really fast for Me, even for Me?

verses.kjv: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
verses.modern: And when You ate and when You drank, did You not eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

verses.kjv: Should ye not hear the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
verses.modern: Should You not have heard the words which the LORD cried out through the former prophets, when Jerusalem and her surrounding cities were inhabited and prosperous, and the south and the plain were inhabited?'"

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,
verses.modern: And the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts says: Execute true judgment, and show mercy and compassion every man to his brother.

verses.kjv: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
verses.modern: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the stranger or the poor. And let none of You devise evil against His brother in Your heart.

verses.kjv: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
verses.modern: But they refused to listen, turned a stubborn shoulder, and stopped their ears so they would not hear.

verses.kjv: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: They made their hearts hard as flint, so they would not hear the law and the words which the LORD of hosts had sent by His Spirit through the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:
verses.modern: Therefore it has come to pass that as He cried out, and they would not hear, so they cried out, and I would not hear, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
verses.modern: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they did not know. So the land was left desolate after them, with no one passing through or returning. For they laid the pleasant land desolate."

chapters.summary: The people ask whether they should continue fasting as they have done during the seventy years of exile. The LORD replies: "When you fasted, did you really fast for Me?" He calls for true justice, mercy, and compassion — not empty rituals. Their fathers refused to listen and made their hearts like flint, so great wrath came from the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,
verses.modern: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts says: I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: I have returned to Zion and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem. And Jerusalem shall be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the Holy Mountain.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: Old men and old women shall yet live in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of his great age.

verses.kjv: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
verses.modern: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvelous in My eyes? says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: I will save My people from the east country and from the west country.

verses.kjv: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
verses.modern: And I will bring them, and they shall live in the midst of Jerusalem. They shall be My people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: Let Your hands be strong, You who hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, who spoke in the day the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.

verses.kjv: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
verses.modern: For before these days there were no wages for man, nor any wages for beast. Nor was there any peace for Him who went out or came in, because of the affliction, for I set every man against his neighbor.

verses.kjv: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
verses.modern: For the seed shall be prosperous, the vine shall give its fruit, and the ground shall give its increase, and the heavens shall give their dew. And I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass, that as You were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so will I save You, and You shall be a blessing. Do not fear, but let Your hands be strong.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD of hosts says: As I purposed to punish You when Your fathers provoked Me to wrath, says the LORD of hosts, and I did not relent,

verses.kjv: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
verses.modern: so again have I purposed in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Do not fear.

verses.kjv: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
verses.modern: These are the things that You shall do: Speak every man the truth to his neighbor; execute the judgment of truth and peace in Your gates.

verses.kjv: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: And let none of You devise evil in Your hearts against His neighbor, and love no false oath. For all these are things that I hate, says the LORD."

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: And the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts to the house of Judah; therefore love the truth and peace.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD of hosts says: The fast of the fourth month, the fast of the fifth, the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth shall be joy and gladness and cheerful feasts to the house of Judah. Therefore love truth and peace.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: Peoples shall yet come, and the inhabitants of many cities.

verses.kjv: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.
verses.modern: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, 'Let us go quickly to pray before the LORD and to seek the LORD of hosts. I will go also.'

verses.kjv: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.
verses.modern: Yes, many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD of hosts says: In those days it shall come to pass that ten men out of all the languages of the nations shall take hold, taking hold of the skirt of a Jew, saying, 'We will go with You, for we have heard that God is with You.'"

chapters.summary: The LORD declares He is jealous for Zion with great fury. He will return and dwell in Jerusalem, and it will be called the city of truth. Old men and old women will again sit in the streets, and boys and girls will play in them. The fasts of mourning will become feasts of joy. Many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the LORD.
verses.modern: The burden of the word of the LORD against the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be its resting place. For the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
verses.modern: And Hamath shall also border on it, as shall Tyrus and Zidon, though they are very wise.

verses.kjv: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
verses.modern: And Tyrus built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like dust and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
verses.modern: But the Lord will cast her out, and He will strike her power on the sea, and she shall be devoured with fire.

verses.kjv: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
verses.modern: Ashkelon shall see it and fear; Gaza also shall see it and be very sorrowful, and Ekron too, for her hope shall be put to shame. The king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

verses.kjv: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.modern: And a mongrel people shall live in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
verses.modern: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth and his abominations from between his teeth. But he who remains, even he, shall be for our God, and He shall be like a governor in Judah, and Ekron like a Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
verses.modern: And I will encamp around My house because of the army, because of him who passes by and because of him who returns. And no oppressor shall pass through them any more, for now I have seen with My own eyes.

verses.kjv: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.modern: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion! Shout, O daughter of Jerusalem! See, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

verses.kjv: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.
verses.modern: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off. And He shall speak peace to the heathen. His dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
verses.modern: As for you also, by the blood of your covenant I have sent out your prisoners from the pit in which there is no water.

verses.kjv: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
verses.modern: Return to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope. Even today I declare that I will give back double to you.

verses.kjv: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
verses.modern: For I have bent Judah for Myself, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and made you like the sword of a mighty man.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.modern: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and His arrow shall go out like lightning. And the Lord GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with the whirlwinds of the south.

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts shall defend them, and they shall devour and subdue with sling stones. And they shall drink and roar as with wine, and they shall be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

verses.kjv: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
verses.modern: And the LORD their God shall save them on that day as the flock of His people. For they shall be like the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign over His land.

verses.kjv: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
verses.modern: For how great is His goodness, and how great is His beauty! Corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces judgment against the surrounding nations — Hadrach, Damascus, Tyre, Sidon, and the Philistine cities. "Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion! Your King is coming to you — righteous and having salvation, lowly and riding upon a donkey." He will speak peace to the heathen, and His dominion will be from sea to sea and from the river to the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
verses.modern: Ask the LORD for rain in the time of the latter rain. So the LORD shall make bright clouds and give them showers of rain, and grass in the field for everyone.

verses.kjv: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
verses.modern: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie. They have told false dreams; they comfort in vain. Therefore the people went their way like a flock; they were troubled because there was no shepherd.

verses.kjv: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
verses.modern: My anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats. For the LORD of hosts has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and has made them like His majestic horse in battle.

verses.kjv: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
verses.modern: Out of Him came forth the corner, out of Him the nail, out of Him the battle bow, out of Him every ruler together.

verses.kjv: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
verses.modern: And they shall be like mighty men who tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in battle. They shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be put to shame.

verses.kjv: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the LORD their God, and will hear them.
verses.modern: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back to live in their place again, for I have mercy on them. And they shall be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.

verses.kjv: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.
verses.modern: And those of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as with wine. Their children shall see it and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
verses.modern: I will whistle for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. And they shall increase as they have increased before.

verses.kjv: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
verses.modern: And I will sow them among the peoples, and they shall remember Me in far countries. They shall live with their children and shall return again.

verses.kjv: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
verses.modern: I will also bring them back out of the land of Egypt and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be room enough for them.

verses.kjv: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
verses.modern: And He shall pass through the sea of affliction and shall strike the waves of the sea. All the depths of the river shall dry up. The pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt shall pass away.

verses.kjv: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: And I will strengthen them in the LORD, and they shall walk up and down in His name, says the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD will give showers of rain — ask Him, not the idols and diviners who speak vanity. The LORD of hosts has visited His flock and will make them as His goodly horse in battle. From Judah will come the cornerstone, the tent peg, and the battle bow. He will strengthen Judah and save Joseph, whistling for them and gathering them, for He has redeemed them.

verses.kjv: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
verses.modern: Open Your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour Your cedars.

verses.kjv: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
verses.modern: Wail, O fir tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the mighty are ruined. Wail, O oaks of Bashan, for the thick forest has come down.

verses.kjv: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
verses.modern: There is the sound of the wailing of the shepherds, for their glory is ruined. There is the sound of the roaring of young lions, for the pride of the Jordan is ruined.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD my God says: "Feed the flock of the slaughter,

verses.kjv: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the LORD; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
verses.modern: whose owners slay them and hold themselves not guilty. And those who sell them say, 'Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich!' And their own shepherds do not pity them.

verses.kjv: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
verses.modern: For I will no longer pity the inhabitants of the land, says the LORD. But I will deliver every man into his neighbor's hand and into the hand of His king. They shall strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them."

verses.kjv: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
verses.modern: So I fed the flock of slaughter, in particular the poor of the flock. And I took for myself two staffs. The one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands. And I fed the flock.

verses.kjv: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
verses.modern: And in one month I cut off three shepherds. My soul loathed them, and their soul also abhorred me.

verses.kjv: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
verses.modern: Then I said, "I will not feed You. Let the one that is dying die, and the one that is to be cut off be cut off. And let the rest eat one another's flesh."

verses.kjv: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
verses.modern: And I took my staff Beauty and broke it apart, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the peoples.

verses.kjv: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the LORD.
verses.modern: And it was broken on that day. So the poor of the flock who watched me knew that it was the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
verses.modern: And I said to them, "If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear." So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: And the LORD said to me, "Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them." And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.modern: Then I broke apart my other staff, Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
verses.modern: And the LORD said to me, "Take to Yourself again the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

verses.kjv: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
verses.modern: For I will raise up a shepherd in the land who shall not care for those that are cut off, nor seek the young one, nor heal the broken, nor feed that which still stands. But He shall eat the flesh of the fat and tear their hooves in pieces.

verses.kjv: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
verses.modern: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword shall be on His arm and on His right eye. His arm shall be completely dried up, and His right eye shall be utterly darkened."

chapters.summary: Zechariah acts out a parable as a shepherd of the flock doomed to slaughter. He takes two staffs — Beauty and Bands — and feeds the flock. He is paid thirty pieces of silver, which the LORD tells him to cast to the potter in the house of the LORD. He breaks both staffs: the covenant with the peoples, and the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

verses.kjv: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
verses.modern: The burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel, says the LORD, Who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within Him:

verses.kjv: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.
verses.modern: "I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling to all the peoples round about, when they shall be in the siege against both Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
verses.modern: And on that day I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all peoples. All who try to lift it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.

verses.kjv: In that day, saith the LORD, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
verses.modern: On that day, says the LORD, I will strike every horse with terror and its rider with madness. And I will keep My eyes open on the house of Judah, and I will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

verses.kjv: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.
verses.modern: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, 'The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.'

verses.kjv: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: On that day I will make the governors of Judah like a hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf. And they shall devour all the surrounding peoples on the right and on the left. And Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
verses.modern: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves above Judah.

verses.kjv: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.
verses.modern: On that day the LORD shall defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. And He who is feeble among them on that day shall be like David, and the house of David shall be like God, like the angel of the LORD before them.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass on that day that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
verses.modern: And I will pour on the house of David and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplications. And they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for Him, as one mourneth for His only son, and shall be in bitterness for Him, as one that is in bitterness for His firstborn.

verses.kjv: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
verses.modern: On that day there shall be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

verses.kjv: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.modern: And the land shall mourn, every family by itself: the family of the house of David by itself, and their wives by themselves; the family of the house of Nathan by itself, and their wives by themselves;

verses.kjv: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
verses.modern: the family of the house of Levi by itself, and their wives by themselves; the family of Shimei by itself, and their wives by themselves;

verses.kjv: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.modern: all the families that remain, every family by itself, and their wives by themselves.

chapters.summary: The LORD will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling to all the surrounding peoples and a burdensome stone for all nations — whoever lifts it will be cut to pieces. In that day the LORD will defend Jerusalem. "They shall look upon Me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for Him as one mourns for an only son."

verses.kjv: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.
verses.modern: On that day a fountain shall be opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
verses.modern: "And it shall come to pass on that day, says the LORD of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no longer be remembered. And I will also cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who gave Him birth shall say to Him, 'You shall not live, for You speak lies in the name of the LORD.' And His father and His mother who gave Him birth shall thrust Him through when He prophesies.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass on that day that every one of the prophets shall be ashamed of his vision when He has prophesied. Nor shall they wear a rough garment to deceive.

verses.kjv: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
verses.modern: But each one shall say, 'I am no prophet; I am a farmer, for a man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.'

verses.kjv: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
verses.modern: And one shall say unto Him, 'What are these wounds in thine hands?' Then He shall answer, 'Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.'

verses.kjv: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
verses.modern: "Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered. And I will turn My hand against the little ones.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the LORD, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass that in all the land, says the LORD, two parts in it shall be cut off and die, but the third shall be left in it.

verses.kjv: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.
verses.modern: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them as gold is tested. They shall call on My name, and I will hear them. I will say, 'It is My people,' and they shall say, 'The LORD is my God.'"

chapters.summary: On that day a fountain will be opened for sin and for uncleanness. The LORD will cut off the names of the idols and remove the unclean spirit and the false prophets from the land. "Awake, O sword, against My shepherd, against the man that is My fellow" — the shepherd will be struck and the sheep scattered. Two parts will be cut off, but a third will be refined through fire and will call on the LORD's name.

verses.kjv: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.
verses.modern: The day of the LORD is coming, and Your plunder shall be divided in Your midst.

verses.kjv: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
verses.modern: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle. The city shall be taken, the houses plundered, and the women ravished. Half of the city shall go out into captivity, but the rest of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

verses.kjv: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
verses.modern: Then the LORD shall go out and fight against those nations, as He fights in the day of battle.

verses.kjv: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
verses.modern: And on that day His feet shall stand upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east. And the mount of Olives shall split in the middle toward the east and toward the west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain shall move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

verses.kjv: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.
verses.modern: And You shall flee to the valley of the mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal. Yes, You shall flee, just as You fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. And the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with You.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass on that day that the light shall not be clear, nor dark.

verses.kjv: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
verses.modern: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night. But it shall come to pass that at evening time it shall be light.

verses.kjv: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass on that day that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. In summer and in winter it shall be so.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
verses.modern: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and His name one.

verses.kjv: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses.
verses.modern: All the land shall be turned into a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem. And Jerusalem shall be lifted up and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel to the king's winepresses.

verses.kjv: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
verses.modern: And men shall live in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction. But Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

verses.kjv: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
verses.modern: And this shall be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem. Their flesh shall waste away while they stand on their feet, their eyes shall waste away in their sockets, and their tongue shall waste away in their mouth.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass on that day that a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them. They shall each seize the hand of His neighbor, and His hand shall rise up against the hand of His neighbor.

verses.kjv: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
verses.modern: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem. And the wealth of all the surrounding heathen shall be gathered together — gold, silver, and clothing in great abundance.

verses.kjv: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
verses.modern: And so shall be the plague on the horse, the mule, the camel, the ass, and all the animals that shall be in these camps, like this plague.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.modern: And it shall come to pass that everyone who is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.
verses.modern: And it shall be that whoever does not come up of all the families of the earth to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, on them there shall be no rain.

verses.kjv: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.modern: And if the family of Egypt does not go up and come, then they shall have no rain. There shall be the plague with which the LORD will strike the heathen that do not come up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.kjv: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.modern: This shall be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all nations that do not come up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.kjv: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD's house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
verses.modern: On that day there shall be inscribed on the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD. And the pots in the LORD's house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

verses.kjv: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts. And all who sacrifice shall come and take of them, and boil in them. And on that day there shall no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.

chapters.summary: The day of the LORD comes — all nations gather against Jerusalem, the city is taken, but the LORD goes forth to fight against those nations. His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, and it will split in two. Living waters will flow from Jerusalem, and the LORD will be king over all the earth. Every survivor from the nations will go up year by year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
